ValidationRule.description: Prevents user from saving the ATM/Card Dispute case record when it's flagged as Scam but no Scam Type value is selected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ATM_Dispute' ), ISPICKVAL( IsAScam__c,'Yes' ), ISPICKVAL( CardScamType__c,'' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You have selected that this transaction is in relation to a scam but have not selected the relevant scam type. Please select the correct scam type then save the case.
